summary: Security release: Microsoft's own sign-in and token checks protect PIM Manager, the request API uses Entra tokens only, and Pro adds a chat in the Manager.

new.title: Chat in the Manager (Pro)
new.text: Ask in plain words and have changes prepared, answered by your own Azure OpenAI deployment without any key, under your own role. Changes are only prepared; you save them. Off by default.

fixes.title: Microsoft's token library
fixes.text: Every sign-in token is checked with Microsoft's own library, which PIM Manager tests at every start before it serves a request.

fixes.title: Your sign-in stays fresh
fixes.text: The page renews your sign-in before it ends, and offers Sign in again or Sign in with another account when needed.

fixes.title: Entra tokens instead of API keys
fixes.text: The access request API accepts only Microsoft Entra application tokens with an app role. Applications on your allow-list get the role automatically.

fixes.title: Commit and Run now within a minute
fixes.text: Commit and Run now wake the engine within about a minute, while the web app still holds no right on the engine's job.

fixes.title: Smaller fixes
fixes.text: The web app holds no Key Vault role (the break-glass passphrase is checked against a protected verifier in the PIM database), and discovery mails are marked as information, not warnings.
